description.value: Hart House Restaurant occupies a historic 1906 Tudor Revival estate on the shores of Deer Lake in Burnaby, set within three acres of landscaped grounds that once housed a celebrated iris garden. The restaurant has operated since 1988, serving Mediterranean-influenced fine dining across lunch, dinner, and weekend brunch in a lakeside setting that has also doubled as a film set. Cyclists passing through the Deer Lake area would find it a distinctive destination for a sit-down meal, with ample free parking on site.

The group-menu page uses dietary codes (V, VG, GF) confirming vegetarian/vegan/GF options; no bike-specific amenities (rack, pump, charging) are mentioned anywhere on the site; washrooms are implicit for a full-service sit-down restaurant confirmed as wheelchair accessible.
